newsitem.title: USA: Home Savings in $70 bln community commitment.
newsitem.headline: Home Savings in $70 bln community commitment.

text.p: The California Reinvestment Committee said on Thursday that H.F. Ahmanson's Home Savings of America announced a $70 billion, 10-year community commitment, setting a standard for banks.
The California Reinvestment Committee is a statewide organization of over 170 nonprofit and public agencies.
Home Savings made this commitment as part of a bid to acquire Great Western Bank, the committee said.
But Home Savings would honor the goals of the deal even if H.F. Ahmanson's bid for Great Western Financial Corp was unsuccessful, although it would make adjustments, it said.

H.F. Ahmanson recently increased its all-stock hostile tender offer for Great Western to at least 1.10 shares for each Great Western share. On March 6, Great Western signed a definitive agreement to be acquired by Washington Mutual Savings Bank in a deal worth $6.6 billion.

The commitment included $500 million for permanent financing of multi-family affordable rental housing, $10 billion in small business loans, $150 million in charitable contributions and community organization support, the committee said.
